findings.location: <article> paragraph: "He wrestled with God..." (source.html third paragraph)
findings.source_quote: As he wrestled with God and pled for victory, he began to hear a recurring message from other professing Christians, “No one is perfect!”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the verb 'wrestled' into natural Portuguese instead of leaving an English form. Replace “wrestlava” with a correct Portuguese equivalent such as “lutou” or “contendia com” (suggested phrasing: “Enquanto ele lutava com Deus e suplicava por vitória, começou a ouvir...” ). Preserve the rest of the sentence and punctuation exactly.
findings.translation_quote: Enquanto ele wrestlava com Deus e suplicava por vitória, começou a ouvir uma mensagem recorrente de outros cristãos professos: “Ninguém é perfeito!”

findings.location: <article> paragraph: "When I joined the Marine Corps..." (Negação de si mesmo section)
findings.source_quote: I remember the first day of boot camp when I joined the Marine Corps after graduating from high school.
